caption: The drawing depicts a single, high-heeled ankle boot oriented to the left, rendered in a dark brown or black color. The boot features a pointed toe and a slightly curved, thick heel. Along the front side, there is a visible row of seven rounded buttons arranged vertically, attached to a scalloped flap that runs up the side of the boot. The background is a solid, light beige or off-white color with no additional objects or decorations. The artist's name, "ARLINGTON GREGO," is faintly inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Shoe
